dialogue_texts: Now, let's peel back the layers of this little incident.
Who is the second entity spreading this perpetual darkness?
If you thought Berenice was one and done, you appear to be heading toward another.
Oh, a multi-layered boundary? How delightful.
I do enjoy a puzzle that requires a bit of effort to unravel.
Well, you won't enjoy the puzzle that awaits you inside...
When I first saw Fusana glohmed again...
I immediately escaped to the Hakurei Shrine as I didn't want to be infected.
A wise retreat, small bird. Now, follow closely behind my gaps.
We are going to cross the boundary and meet this second troublemaker.
